title: Contents Packout & Storage Furniture Coverage Rider
content:
On Contents Packout & Storage declared-value coverage for Partial Contents Packout and Full Contents Packout jobs, furniture carries a coverage rider: **when the furniture item quantities on the job's packout lines total at least the furniture rider threshold, the large furniture rider is added to the valuation percentage; when they total at least one item but fewer than the furniture rider threshold, the small furniture rider is added; a job with no furniture item on its packout lines carries no furniture rider.**

| Furniture items on the job's packout lines | Rider added to the valuation percentage |
|---|---|
| 20 or more (at least the furniture rider threshold) | 0.04 (large furniture rider) |
| 1 to 19 | 0.02 (small furniture rider) |
| none | none |

The items counted are the quantities on the furniture packing lines (blanket wrap and move out per furniture item) booked on the job.

**Boundary cases.** 19 furniture items: 0.02. 20 items: 0.04. No furniture line: no rider.
